summary: Two components cover REQ-001..005, with a single interface IF-001 (price_order) linking receipt to pricing. Data flows are consistent, the injection trade-off is justified, and the integration strategy exercises IF-001 via the default pricer. Only minor remarks.

checklist.item: Every requirement realised by a component

checklist.note: IF-001 has signature; return dict shape fixed in ASM-001
REQ-005 via pricer injection with default, stdlib only
render_receipt without pricer runs real price_order

findings.description: IF-001 error path (ValueError from price_order propagating through render_receipt) is not stated in the interface description or integration strategy; should be defined at G3.
REQ-005 has no acceptance criteria; it is verified via the architecture/test structure.
